shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
printf '\\n-- package/test config --\\n'
rg --files -g 'package.json' -g 'vitest.config.*' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml' -g 'src/transport/**/*.test.ts' -g 'src/types/messages.ts' -g 'src/transport/ws/{validation,messageHandler,sender}.ts' -g 'src/transport/createServer.ts' -g 'specs/**' | sort
printf '\\n-- validation --\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
printf '\\n-- handler --\\n'
sed -n '1,300p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
printf '\\n-- message types --\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/types/messages.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- sender/createServer/session store/config --'
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/sender.ts
rg -n \"createMessageHandler|history|resume|listFor|StoreCannotList|ErrorCodes\" src/transport/createServer.ts src/config.ts src/types/sessionStore.ts src/types/session.ts src/index.ts example/full-config.ts
printf '%s\\n' '-- failing test areas --'
sed -n '1,150p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,150p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/types/messages.test.ts
printf '%s\\n' '-- acceptance test --'
sed -n '1,320p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
printf '%s\\n' '-- test commands --'
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
printf '%s\\n' '-- spec status --'
head -40 specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list|list_conversations|conversation_list|Status|WebSocket\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | head -100
sed -n '1,100p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
sed -n '25,55p' src/types/session.ts
sed -n '1,140p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '1,125p' src/config.ts
rg -n \"SessionListMessage|ListSessionsMessage|SessionSummaryFrame|session_list\" src/index.ts src -g '*.ts' | head -80
rg -n \"re-lint/(max-expects|prefer-polymorphism|max-boolean-operators|no-nested-if|test-imports-its-subject|require-spec-link)\" .eslintrc* eslint* package.json src | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/types/index.ts src/types/messages.test.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/types/messages.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts src/types/messages.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat
git status --short
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,35p' src/types/index.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/index.ts src/types/index.ts src/types/messages.ts src/types/messages.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Add conversation list message validation" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
